title: Tuesday in 12 links that explain the market's wildest moves: SELLAS+143%, Salesforce -9%. What mattered most?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Software sold off hard, with Salesforce down about 9% and Intuit 6% as  
investors cut AI and enterprise-software risk. SELLAS more than  
doubled on Phase 3 data, Tucows jumped 24% on the Ting sale, and Elbit  
rose 7% after earnings. Here's Tuesday in one thread. Which story are  
you opening first?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Salesforce (CRM)\*\* — Salesforce dropped -9.11%, falling from the  
prior close of $214.83 to $195.26, with nearly all of the decline  
occurring during regular trading after premarket was only slightly  
lower. The move was driven by a sector-wide de-rating of seat-based  
application software, as investors argued AI agents undermine per-user  
subscription pricing and funds freed up cash ahead of Anthropic's IPO  
and Nvidia's results...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-salesforce-inc-crm-stock-down-8-83-today-39871/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-salesforce-inc-crm-stock-down-8-83-today-39871/)  
  
\*\*2. Intuit (INTU)\*\* — INTU dropped -6.02% to $324.77 from Monday's  
close of $345.56, a decline of -$20.79, with the selling occurring  
during Tuesday's regular session after shares opened lower. The move  
was sector-driven, not company-specific: application-software names  
sold off as the 10-year Treasury yield held near 5.1% and investors  
cut AI exposure ahead of Nvidia's after-close results, with Salesforce  
(-6%) and Workday...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-intuit-intu-stock-down-6-02-today-39877/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-intuit-intu-stock-down-6-02-today-39877/)  
  
\*\*3. ServiceNow (NOW)\*\* — ServiceNow (NOW) shares have declined  
roughly 30% over the past 30 days, driven by a historic post-earnings  
selloff on October 29.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/servicenow-now-slides-30-in-30-days-after-q3-earnings-miss-39444/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/servicenow-now-slides-30-in-30-days-after-q3-earnings-miss-39444/)  
  
\*\*4. SELLAS Life Sciences Group (SLS)\*\* — Shares jumped +142.57% to  
$18.12 from Monday's $7.47 close, with the advance occurring during  
Tuesday's regular session after premarket quotes ran even higher. The  
trigger was the topline Phase 3 REGAL readout: galinpepimut-S (GPS)  
met its primary overall survival endpoint in acute myeloid leukemia  
patients in second complete remission, a result the company called  
pivotal.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sellas-life-sciences-group-sls-stock-up-164-12-today-39823/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sellas-life-sciences-group-sls-stock-up-164-12-today-39823/)  
  
\*\*5. Tucows (TCX)\*\* — TCX jumped to $14.17 in Tuesday morning  
regular-session trading from Monday's close of $11.45, a gain of  
\+23.76% (+$2.72), after the news broke before the opening bell. The  
catalyst was a definitive agreement to sell Ting Holdco — Ting Fiber's  
owned fiber markets and their securitized financing facility — to  
Clearwave for nominal cash, removing roughly $301.5 million of  
principal securitized notes from...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-tucows-inc-tcx-stock-up-28-03-today-39868/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-tucows-inc-tcx-stock-up-28-03-today-39868/)  
  
\*\*6. Elbit Systems (ESLT)\*\* — Elbit Systems stock jumped +7.30%,  
rising from the prior close of $680.74 to $730.45, with the move  
taking place during Tuesday's regular session. The gain followed  
third-quarter results released before the open: adjusted EPS of $4.36  
beat the \~$3.79 consensus, revenue grew +17.2% to $2.25 billion, and  
order backlog hit a record $33 billion.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-elbit-systems-ltd-eslt-stock-up-7-30-today-39802/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-elbit-systems-ltd-eslt-stock-up-7-30-today-39802/)  
  
\*\*7. Omeros (OMER)\*\* — OMER dropped -18.76%, from Monday's $16.68  
close to $13.55 in early Tuesday regular-session trading, extending a  
roughly -10% after-hours slide that began with Monday's post-close  
report. Third-quarter net YARTEMLEA product revenue of $35.9 million  
missed the \~$37.3 million consensus, and the gross-to-net discount  
widened to 14% from 11.5%, with management guiding that figure toward  
the high teens.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-omeros-corporation-omer-stock-down-19-84-today-39751/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-omeros-corporation-omer-stock-down-19-84-today-39751/)  
  
\*\*8. Arm (ARM)\*\* — Arm Holdings (ARM) shares fell roughly 23% over the  
trailing 30 days, sliding from about $227.80 (October 16 close) to  
around $175.03.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/arm-holdings-arm-stock-falls-23-in-30-days-earnings-miss-and-sector-reset-39440/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/arm-holdings-arm-stock-falls-23-in-30-days-earnings-miss-and-sector-reset-39440/)  
  
\*\*9. Lumentum (LITE)\*\* — The central target of $1,080 is the  
arithmetic mean of roughly two dozen current analyst price targets,  
which span approximately $685 to $1,425. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/lumentum-holdings-lite-can-it-reach-1-080-98-upside-after-the-marvell-takeover-39464/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/lumentum-holdings-lite-can-it-reach-1-080-98-upside-after-the-marvell-takeover-39464/)  
  
\*\*10. Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN)\*\* — Regeneron Pharmaceuticals  
(REGN) rose roughly 20% over the past 30 days, from an adjusted close  
of about $790.74 on October 16, 2026, to about $952.40 on November 16,  
2026.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/regeneron-pharmaceuticals-regn-climbs-20-on-strong-q3-results-39442/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/regeneron-pharmaceuticals-regn-climbs-20-on-strong-q3-results-39442/)  
  
\*\*11. GraniteShares 2x Long RDDT Daily ETF (RDTL)\*\* — RDTL declined  
roughly 72% over the trailing 30 days, falling from about $12.89 to  
$3.60, as 2x daily leverage amplified a sharp selloff in Reddit  
shares.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/graniteshares-2x-long-rddt-daily-etf-rdtl-falls-72-over-30-days-as-reddit-volatility-hits-hard-39449/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/graniteshares-2x-long-rddt-daily-etf-rdtl-falls-72-over-30-days-as-reddit-volatility-hits-hard-39449/)  
  
\*\*12. Golden Heaven Group Holdings (GDHG)\*\* — GDHG tumbled from  
Monday's $1.58 close to $0.4425, a -72.15% move, during Tuesday's  
regular session, erasing the bulk of the prior day's +91.45% gain. No  
verified news or fundamental catalyst found: there was no new company  
release, filing or analyst action behind the drop.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-golden-heaven-group-holdings-ltd-gdhg-stock-down-71-52-today-39776/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-golden-heaven-group-holdings-ltd-gdhg-stock-down-71-52-today-39776/)  
  
What was Tuesday's most important move, and which story are you opening first?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
